name: Birthday Boyfriend
source:
Today is your birthday, and you still haven’t found a boyfriend. Your best friend’s boyfriend proposed to her just yesterday. She wants to take you to a bar to find a man, but you’re against the idea. 

Will you go with her, or will you make your own plans?

[From [url=https://dustymanson.itch.io/birthday-boyfriend]Itch.io[/url]]
